description: Records a card the user bought to their SlabLineage collection with the price actually paid, on the Deal Desk session. Before calling, ask the user "Record <card> bought for $<price>?" and pass confirm true after they say yes. Give dealId from check_deal (preferred) or the same card fields as check_deal; for a slab pass certNumber read off the label when visible; quantity is for raw cards. PSA and TAG slabs with a cert SlabLineage can check go in the collection; other slabs are logged in Deal Desk without joining the collection (the pc.message says which). Pass an idempotencyKey so a retry never records twice. When the result has a nextLine (offering to list the card for sale), ask it. Where the assistant shows panels, the result opens a photo panel where the user can take the card's photo for the listing. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

cardId.description: SlabLineage card id from search_cards (any row of the card). Give cardId or the catalog id; one of them is required.

certNumber.description: The cert number on the slab label, when visible.

confirm.description: True once the user said yes to recording this purchase; never set it before that.

grade.description: The grade on the slab label, e.g. "10" or "9.5". Not needed for RAW.

grader.description: Without dealId: the grading company on the label (PSA, TAG, CGC, BGS …) or RAW.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique key for this record (any short text you make up once); a retry with the same key never records twice.

pricePaid.description: The price the user actually paid in USD (the total for the quantity).

scrydexCardId.description: Or the card's catalog id, e.g. "sv3pt5-199" (when you have it instead of cardId).

name: record_purchase
title: Record a purchase
